headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 18, 2026, the portfolio set is showing a year-to-date return of 24.38%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.41%. This results in an average alpha of 10.98%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved an impressive return of 47.70%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', still maintains a return of 13.56%, which is above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly noteworthy during times of market volatility and uncertainty. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
